description: Post a reply on one of the account's tickets, as the user; the team is notified. Use it to answer a question the team asked or to add information, rather than opening a new ticket. A resolved ticket cannot be replied to: open a new one. Needs the support scope.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string with no spaces, such as a UUID. If this call fails or times out and you try again, pass the same value both times and it happens once.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id (UUID), from list_tickets or open_ticket

name: reply_ticket
title: Reply on a support ticket
